t: A 15 step challenge that turns a dance routine into a coded sequence with loops.
steps: Find the Dance Coding Challenge on the DIY.org site.
Read the 15 steps and the tips for your age group.
Gather paper, index cards, scissors, tape, and a timer.
Clear space for students to dance.
Pick a block coding app if you plan the digital step.
Review the DIY.org terms before students post any work.
Have students lay out eight cards and test the routine.
